From helping guests and fulfilling digital orders to unloading trucks, stocking shelves and keeping teams focused on the right work, the shopping experience depends on the outcome of hundreds of small but consequential decisions that a store team makes every day. What needs attention first? Where should a team member go next? How can leaders keep work moving while giving guests an easy, inspiring and friendly experience? Navigating that work can also require juggling a mix of data sources, apps and devices. In response, we are accelerating technology in a very Target way: listening to our team, understanding their core challenges and building new, smarter tools that make our stores simpler to run. New data and technology in myDay, Target’s store operations app used by more than 350,000 team members, brings together information and work from across the store, turning it into a clearer view of what needs attention and where to start. Store leaders can see more of what’s happening across the store — from fulfillment orders and truck unloads to team members’ schedules — all in one place. Leaders can customize their view so the information they need most is easy to find. Team members get a clear, prioritized to-do list, helping them know what to work on next. The impact is already clear.
